text: Tick ~447: after first tree chop (5 wood, objective Wood 5/10), tip popup says 'Tip 3 of 5: Gather stone' while objective 1 is still Gather wood. Tips 1-2 never seen on screen (state had walk/look tip at tick 27 but screen only showed Welcome status). Mixed signals for new player. Also state.json objective.progress says 'Wood 0/10' while screen shows 5/10.

Tick 1003: Objective 2 'Eat something' completed 52 ticks after it appeared without me pressing any key (I only waited 4s). Apples 3 -> 5 (only the +2 reward), chicken meat unchanged at 2, so nothing was eaten. The objective flashed past before I could even read how to eat. Expected: completes only when I eat.

Tick 2995: Found Settlement refused with a helpful message 'Open ground lies about 81 to the north', but there is no compass or north indicator anywhere on the HUD, so a new player cannot tell which way north is. (Had to look in state/code: north is +Z.)

Tick ~4800: Inside/near own settlement the floating world label '0 here, 0/8 residents' is rendered huge across the top of the screen behind the chronicle and status toast, half-hidden and hard to read. It also says 0/8 residents while Settlement Info panel says Residents 2/8.

Tick 6183: Goal check. Founded Greentown at tick 4163 and entered at 4303 with no materials; ~1900 ticks later (resident Ruth Walker present, residents 2/8) Market Info still shows 0/4 stalls and objective 6 'Build a market stall' was NOT completed. Residents did not build a stall in my settlement. Side note: Inventory panel jumped from the left column to the middle of the screen in this layout, and my own resident is labelled 'Talk to Ruth Walker (Stranger)'.

Tick 6255/6303: Pressed B inside Greentown with 24 wood/5 stone -> 'Stall built.', Market 1/4 stalls, objective 6 completed at tick 6303 (ticksTaken 2000). GOAL ANSWER: objective completed only when I built the stall; residents built none first. New objective 7 progress bar text is clipped on the left: 'nbers 2/10 - Buildings 0/2' (Members cut off).

Tick ~6400: Game runs at fps 0-2 and tps 3-5 (of 50) on this shared machine; clicking '? Controls' did not visibly open within 3s. Likely load from parallel sessions, but game time runs ~10x slower than real time.
